title: Picture stories
sub: Short stories told in numbered panels.

items.heading: A boastful hare
items.body: The hare laughs at the slow tortoise and challenges it to a race.

items.heading: Racing ahead
items.body: The hare sprints far in front and decides to nap under a tree.

items.heading: Slow and steady
items.body: The tortoise keeps walking and never stops.

items.heading: The winner
items.body: The tortoise crosses the line first. Steady effort beats overconfidence.
